about: Every feature of Freally OS, one tagged spec each, driven over CDP by tools/cdp-runner. A feature without a spec, or a spec without a feature, fails the run.

features.what: The bootloader verifies the signed image and paints Freally OS vX.Y.Z in Noto Sans: the whole screen, pixel for pixel.
One flipped bit in the image gets the integrity screen, with the reason, and nothing from the image runs.
A release bootloader boots its staging-signed release image.
A release bootloader refuses a dev-signed image: a key this computer doesn't trust.
Boot services exit, the runtime services move to the direct map, and Freally Core is entered with a BootInfo it accepts, then paints its screen.
A kernel fault stops on the panic screen in Noto, naming the exception, its RIP and the machine state, drawn exactly as the kernel logs it.
A kernel panic survives a warm reboot: the next boot finds the last-panic page, files it as a fault report from freally-core, and logs it once.
Freally Core starts conductor from the image as PID 1, its ELF re-checked and loaded W^X; conductor says it started and C0 is stamped.
